Settings is laid out like KnightLoader now: a column of fourteen pages right beside the sidebar, each with its own address, and a search that appears when you scroll up and takes you to any setting. Pairing has a page of its own.

## 🎨 Changed

### Settings

- **The eight tabs become fourteen pages** in a column beside the sidebar: General, Look, Storage, Retention, Schedules, Containers, Off-site, Cloud access, Notifications, Integrity, Security, Pairing, Integrations and System. Retention, Containers, Cloud access, Security, Pairing and Integrations used to be parts of other tabs.
- **Every page has its own address**, such as `/settings/offsite`, so a page can be bookmarked and the Back button returns to the page before. Settings opens on the page you had open last. Links to the old tabs and to `/jobs` lead to the matching page.
- **Hold a tile and drag it to reorder the column.** The order is saved with your other display settings. The arrow keys, Home and End move between pages.
- **In a narrow window the column shows only the symbols.** It follows **Labels, Tabs** on the Look page too: with Symbol each tile shows its symbol alone, and with Reactive the name opens under the symbol when you point at a tile. The current page keeps its name. Each tile takes its colour from its place in the column, as the tabs did.
- **Search all settings appears when you scroll up** on a settings page, and goes away when you scroll down or change page, so it does not take room on every page. It searches page names, card titles, the caption beside each control and the explanations behind the (i), but not the values you have set. Picking a result opens its page, scrolls to the card or row and marks it. When the result is hidden at the moment, because it belongs to the advanced view or to a feature that is off, a note says so.
- **Pairing is always in the column.** Receiver, Instances and Pull, the three features that work through pairing, are switched on in the Domains card on the General page. Until one of them is on, the Pairing page says so.
- **Restart after backup moves to the Containers page**, below the registries.
- **Every settings card fits beside the column on a phone** down to 320 pixels wide. Long titles, paths and rows wrap instead of running off the side.
- **In rainbow mode each path row on the Storage page has its own colour** for its Local/Remote switch and its Browse button, instead of six rows in one colour.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Hints that named a place in Settings point at the right page.** The pairing hint on the Instances page, the off-site retention note, the repository and backup location hints, the MCP sign-in messages, the host SSH notes and the orphan image note still named the old tabs or cards that had moved.

## 🌐 Translations

- The page names, the search, the pairing page and the corrected hints in all 42 languages. Swedish calls off-site Extern throughout.
- The documentation in all 26 languages names the new pages. The translated pages also carry the sections they were missing: SMB and WebDAV without a host mount, Not backed up, the retention preview, the support bundle, pulling from another instance, the sealed recovery kit and remote primary repositories. The Arabic and Greek pages quote the app's own button and page names, and the Portuguese, Greek and Ukrainian pages keep to one form of address.

## Upgrading

- **Nothing has to be changed.** Settings carry over as they are, and bookmarks to the old tabs lead to the matching page.
- **The column starts in the default order.** Drag a tile to change it.
